sections.title: Felé: in the direction of
sections.content: *Felé* means "towards". It works like the other place words: it follows the noun and the noun does not change. *A park felé megyek.* (I am going towards the park.) It tells the direction you are heading, not the place you will arrive at; for arriving you know *a parkba megyek*.

sections.title: Asking the direction
sections.content: Ask *Merre mész?* (Which way are you going?) and answer with *felé*: *Az állomás felé.* You know *merre* from asking the way.

items.english: I am going towards the park.

items.spanish: A busz a múzeum felé megy.
items.english: The bus is going towards the museum.
We are walking towards the square.

sections.content: *A parkba megyek* means you will be in the park; *A park felé megyek* only says you are heading that way.
